job: Make someone type a name before a destructive action runs.
purpose: A dialog for actions that destroy something with history in it: a team, a project, all logs. A phrase (the slug, in mono) is shown, and the danger button stays disabled until the field matches it exactly after trimming spaces. Submitting fires a cancelable fd:confirm; cancel it to run async work, then closeDialog(id, "confirm").
useWhen: Deleting a team, project or workspace along with its keys, monitors and logs.
A mistake cannot be undone and has a wide blast radius.

avoidWhen.when: A simple yes or no with no history lost.
A single record in a row.
Revoking a key with an inline confirmation button.

states.name: armed
states.how: the submit button is enabled once the input matches data-confirm

states.name: busy
states.how: aria-busy on the button while async work runs after fd:confirm

variants.useWhen: The field whose value must match the phrase.

parts.role: The dialog (also carries fd-dialog); data-confirm holds the phrase.
The phrase shown in mono, selectable in one click.
